title: Universe enlargement compatible with enriched tensor comparison
statement:
Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'\in\mathcal U''$ and use [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and [lem-coef-cocomplete-monoidal-tensor]. Let $V,W$ be $\mathcal U'$-small monoidal infinity categories with all $\mathcal U$-small colimits, whose tensors preserve these colimits separately. After increasing $\mathcal U'$ if necessary to contain the cocomplete tensor $V\otimes_{\mathrm{coc},\mathcal U}W$, there are $\mathcal U'$-presentably monoidal infinity categories $\widehat V,\widehat W$ and fully faithful strong monoidal embeddings
$$j_V:V\hookrightarrow\widehat V,\quad j_W:W\hookrightarrow\widehat W,\quad j_{VW}:V\otimes_{\mathrm{coc},\mathcal U}W\hookrightarrow\widehat V\otimes_{\mathrm{coc},\mathcal U'}\widehat W$$
preserving $\mathcal U$-small colimits and satisfying $j_{VW}\mu\simeq\widehat\mu(j_V\times j_W)$. The embeddings $j_V,j_W$ may be chosen as Yoneda embeddings into $\mathcal U'$-space-valued presheaves on $V,W$, respectively, localized at the arrows $\operatorname{colim}_K y(p)\to y(\operatorname{colim}_Kp)$ for all $\mathcal U$-small diagrams $p$; the latter is a $\mathcal U'$-small collection after enlargement. The embedding $j_{VW}$ is the induced fully faithful map from the smaller-universe cocomplete tensor into the larger-universe tensor of these two localized presheaf categories. No local $\mathcal U$-smallness hypothesis on $V,W$ is imposed. In this notation $\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U}$ means that object spaces are $\mathcal U$-small. The induced functors
$$J_V:\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U}(V)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U'}(\widehat V),\quad J_W:\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U}(W)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U'}(\widehat W),$$
$$J_{VW}:\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U}(V\otimes_{\mathrm{coc},\mathcal U}W)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Algd}_{\mathcal U'}(\widehat V\otimes_{\mathrm{coc},\mathcal U'}\widehat W)$$
are fully faithful and preserve $\mathcal U$-small colimits. They satisfy a coherent equivalence
$$J_{VW}\bigl(\mu_*(A\boxtimes B)\bigr)\simeq\widehat\mu_*(J_VA\boxtimes J_WB).$$
All the displayed larger categories are formed in $\mathcal U''$.
